name: Primalist Vitality Surge: effective healing, raid haste and stacking
contract: Effective direct and periodic heals trigger the 25% raid haste proc. Measure 180 direct and 32 single-tick trials; full overhealing, absent talent and removal are negative controls. Native party propagation grants 5% melee/ranged and spell haste for 20 seconds and never stacks with equal raid haste. An ungrouped player receives no buff.
